messages:
maia: Heads-up — we have an Acme dedicated tenant (tenant-42) reporting intermittent 503s + occasional OOMs on a worker pod. Raised by customer at 08:12PT. Requesting repro bundle and quick collection steps so SRE can triage. Request-id: 01H7KZQ4X9.

maia: Observed pod: tenant-42/worker-7, node: ip-10-2-5-3, model served: rw-inference/redwood-1-8b, approximate time window: 2026-03-16T15:02:11Z -> 15:04:30Z. Can someone help gather kernel logs, nvidia-smi, pod logs, and a curl repro?

maia: Minimal repro curl the customer used:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"summarize: The quarterly financials...","max_tokens":64}' \
  https://dedicated.api.redwood.company/tenant/42/v1/generate?model=redwood-1
```

maia: Please collect these artifacts and upload to support bundle: /var/log/pods/*logs, /var/log/kern.log (or journalctl -k), dmesg tail, and nvidia-smi -q output. Example commands to run on the node/pod: 
```bash
# pod logs
kubectl -n tenant-42 logs pod/worker-7 -c inference --tail=1000 > /tmp/worker-7.logs.txt

# capture GPU and kernel info inside pod (if allowed)
kubectl -n tenant-42 exec worker-7 -c inference -- bash -lc "nvidia-smi -q > /tmp/nvidia.txt || true; dmesg | tail -n 300 > /tmp/dmesg.txt || true"

# node-level captures (run from infra or node ssh)
ssh core@ip-10-2-5-3 'sudo dmesg | tail -n 400' > /tmp/node-dmesg.txt
ssh core@ip-10-2-5-3 'sudo journalctl -k --no-pager -n 500' > /tmp/kern.log
```

maia: Upload pattern we prefer:
```bash
tar czf /tmp/3081234567-acme-supplemental.tar.gz /tmp/worker-7.logs.txt /tmp/nvidia.txt /tmp/dmesg.txt /tmp/kern.log
aws s3 cp /tmp/3081234567-acme-supplemental.tar.gz s3://redwood-support-bundles/3081234567/
```

oncall-bot: TRACE created: TRACE-3081234567. Please include kernel messages around XID, output of "dmesg | grep -i xid" and full outputs of `nvidia-smi -q`. Also attach `kubectl get events -n tenant-42 --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp | tail -n 50`.

ravi: I can take node-level capture. Quick note: if customer can reproduce, start a short tcpdump for TLS handshake timing and collect /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/* for the pod. Example one-liner: 
```bash
kubectl -n tenant-42 exec worker-7 --container=inference -- bash -lc "cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.usage_in_bytes > /tmp/mem-usage.txt"
ssh core@ip-10-2-5-3 'sudo tcpdump -i any -w /tmp/3081234567-ssl.pcap port 443 and host 10.2.5.12' & sleep 60; sudo pkill -f tcpdump
```

olivia: Also add Prometheus queries for GPU errors / OOMs — quick query examples for SRE: 
```bash
# GPU memory OOM events (if exporter available)
curl -s 'http://prometheus.monitoring.svc:9090/api/v1/query?query=rate(nvidia_gpu_memory_errors_total[5m])'
# GPU utilisation window around failure
curl -s "http://prometheus.monitoring.svc:9090/api/v1/query?query=avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_utilization[5m])"
```

sam: Checklist (short):
• collect request-id headers from customer logs (they sent 01H7KZQ4X9)
• pod logs + kubectl describe pod
• node dmesg + journalctl -k
• nvidia-smi -q and dmesg | grep -i xid
• prometheus queries (memory_errors, gpu_utilization)
• tcpdump if TLS timings needed

sam: If they can reproduce, ask them to attach header "x-request-id: 01H7KZQ4X9" to the curl so we can map traces to our proxy logs.

maia: Customer says they can repro intermittently. I'm going to request the bundle and will paste the s3 link once uploaded. Thanks all — please ping if I forget something. :handshake:

oncall-bot: Reminder: include kernel version and driver versions (nvidia-smi output contains this). Created support ticket ENG-SUP-308123.

ravi: I'll follow up once tcpdump and node captures are uploaded to the S3 path.

maia: Appreciate it — I'll coordinate upload with Acme and add the trace id in the ticket.
